raw_segments.text: Inasmuch, resumed the judge, as the English law protects equally and sternly the religions of the Indian people, and as the man Passepartout has admitted that he violated the sacred pagoda of Malabar Hill, at Bombay, on the 20th of October, I condemn the said Passepartout to imprisonment for fifteen days and a fine of three hundred pounds.

Inasmuch, resumed the judge, as the man Passepartout to imprisonment for fifteen days and a fine of three hundred pounds, I condemn the judge, as the man Passepartout to impeachment for fifteen days and a fine of three hundred pounds.
